# stacklet_saml_provider (Data Source)

Retrieve information about a SAML identity provider by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch SAML provider information by name
data "stacklet_saml_provider" "example" {
  name = "okta"
}

output "saml_provider_display_name" {
  value = data.stacklet_saml_provider.example.display_name
}

output "saml_provider_metadata_url" {
  value = data.stacklet_saml_provider.example.metadata_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name identifying the provider.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the SAML provider.
- `enable_signout` (Boolean) Whether the identity provider signout flow is enabled for this provider.
- `id` (String) The GraphQL Node ID of the SAML provider.
- `idp_alias` (String) A unique human-facing alias for the provider.
- `metadata_url` (String) URL of the SAML metadata endpoint, if the provider is configured with one.
- `metadata_xml` (String) Inline SAML metadata XML document, if the provider is configured with one.
